stem: Positron emission tomography (PET scanning) obtains diagnostic information from a person. The information is used to form an image.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
PET scanning uses a tracer.

Explain what is meant by a tracer.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by annihilation.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the names of the particles involved in the annihilation process.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the total energy released in one annihilation event in (b).

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the wavelength of each gamma photon released.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain how the gamma photons are used to produce an image.
